items.fact: On 2026-09-25, for the double-well run's sample, the person gave the focus position of the bottom substrate as z = 2971.04 um.
items.how: Said to this seat in its window, in two messages: 'here is the bottom substrate', then 'z:2971.04um'. This seat opened no device and read no position.

source.recorded_at: the message of the commit that adds microscope_agent/findings/microscope-20260924-6-20260925.json (git log --diff-filter=A -- that path), which quotes the person's words

items.note: A session event for this mount, listed so the bead's height above the substrate can be computed against it: the reference for the bead-height hand-over statement. Not stated: which drive reported it (the stand's focus drive, presumably, as read in NIS or Micro-Manager), which objective was in place, how the surface was judged in focus, or whether PFS was engaged. A focus-drive difference is not a height in the sample: through oil into water the axial scale differs, and that correction is not applied here.
